source: OSRS Wiki: {{LocLine}} and the map of the articles Dark wizard, Undead tree, Vine (Draynor Manor), Jail guard (checked 2026-09-27)

zones.name: Dark Wizards Circle
zones.message: DANGER: the level 7 and 20 dark wizards at the stone circle south of Varrock attack on their own and hit with magic. Stay away from the circle.
zones.hud: Dark wizard zone! Stay away from the circle.
zones.source: Dark wizard: LocLine "Varrock stone circle", 11 points 3223-3232 x 3363-3374; aggressive = Yes

zones.name: Dark Wizards behind Draynor bank
zones.message: Careful: level 7 dark wizards stand behind the Draynor bank and attack on their own. The shrimp fishing spot is nearby, fish further south.
zones.hud: Dark wizards behind the Draynor bank.
zones.source: Dark wizard: LocLine "Behind Draynor Village bank", 3084,3236 and 3085,3238

zones.name: Draynor Manor Undead Trees
zones.message: DANGER: in the Draynor Manor yard the animated trees hit anyone passing by, and invisible vines at the south-east corner sting every 3 seconds. Do not run straight across the yard.
zones.source: Undead tree: the article map, 10 points of the yard 3103-3122 x 3335-3348; Vine (Draynor Manor): 3118,3342, r=7

zones.name: Draynor Jail Guards
zones.message: Careful: the level 26 jail guards by Draynor Jail are aggressive and chase you along the road. Stay away from the jail.
zones.source: Jail guard: LocLine "Draynor Village jail", 3109-3127 x 3237-3249; aggressive2-4 = Yes
